result.payback_rule: payback_year = first year from which the saving stays at or above zero up to year 12; null = not within 12 years

depreciation_curve.ev: BFE/EBP 2023, Figure 2 (Eurotax retail values of EVs, share of new price), ages 1–8 for small and medium cars; large cars use the medium curve; beyond 8 years extrapolated with −20 % per year; ±2 percentage points per 10,000 km above or below 15,000 km a year, at most down to 40 % and up to 125 % of the typical value; the value never rises with time
depreciation_curve.ev_used: used EV bought at age 4: price = new price × value share at that age; its value later = new price × share at age 4 + years kept (so from about 5 years kept the curve is extrapolated)
depreciation_curve.current_car: your value today (or estimate: new price × 0.85 per year of age, minus 1 % of the new price per 10,000 km above 15,000 km a year, at least 5 %); from today −18 % per year (our assumption, close to Eurotax-type curves), plus −2 % per 10,000 km above 15,000 km a year
depreciation_curve.uncertainty: residual value band ±15 % where the EV curve is data, ±30 % where it is extrapolated or beyond 8 years; your car ±20 % (±30 % beyond 8 years)
depreciation_curve.battery: warranty assumed 8 years / 160,000 km (typical, check your offer); replacement scenario CHF 250 per kWh gross capacity (Nissan list prices 2022 via Auto Bild / t-online), shown separately: the residual values are market prices of cars with their original battery and do not include a replacement

statements.text: Kept for 1 year, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 2,200 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 2,600 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 2 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 4,400 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 4,700 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 3 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 6,600 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 7,000 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 4 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 8,900 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 8,800 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 5 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 11,100 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 10,400 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 6 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 13,400 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 11,900 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 7 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 15,800 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 13,600 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 8 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 18,200 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 15,500 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 9 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 20,600 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 17,500 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 10 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 23,000 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 19,600 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 11 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 25,500 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 21,700 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.

Kept for 12 years, Option 1 (M1, used) saves you about CHF 28,000 (pays off after about 1 year); Option 2 (L1, used) saves you about CHF 23,900 (pays off after about 1 year) compared with keeping your BMW 530xd.
